messages.content:
Analyze the following resume text and extract structured information.
Return ONLY valid JSON with no markdown formatting.

Resume:
"""
Divya Menon
Thiruvananthapuram | divya.qa@example.com

SUMMARY
SDET who builds test automation frameworks and quality gates for CI.

SKILLS
Selenium, Playwright, Cypress, Appium, REST Assured, Postman, JMeter, k6, Java, TypeScript, TestNG, Allure, Jenkins

EXPERIENCE
Senior SDET, UST Global (2020 - Present)
Built a Playwright framework in TypeScript that replaced 1,800 manual regression cases.
Cut the regression suite runtime from 6 hours to 40 minutes with parallel sharding.
Added contract tests between 14 microservices using Pact.
Ran load tests with k6 before the annual sale, finding a connection pool bottleneck at 4k RPS.

QA Engineer, Tata Consultancy Services (2017 - 2020)
Automated mobile regression tests with Appium for an airline booking app.

EDUCATION
B.Tech Computer Science, College of Engineering Trivandrum, 2017

CERTIFICATIONS
ISTQB Certified Tester Foundation Level

"""

Return this exact JSON structure:
{
  "skills": ["skill1", "skill2", ...],
  "experience_summary": "A 2-3 sentence summary of their work experience",
  "projects": ["Project 1: brief description", ...],
  "education": "Degree, University, Year"
}

Rules:
- skills: extract ALL technical and soft skills mentioned
- experience_summary: summarize roles, companies, and years of experience
- projects: list each project with a one-line description
- education: most recent degree with institution
- If a section is not found, use empty string or empty array
